newsitem.title: UK: Tesco bans unprocessed gene maize as animal feed.
newsitem.headline: Tesco bans unprocessed gene maize as animal feed.

text.p: British supermarket chain Tesco Plc is to ban unprocessed genetically modified maize as an animal feed ingredient within its supply chain, the company said in a statement.
The move follows concerns raised by the government's advisory committee about the environmental impact of the unprocessed producers, Tesco said.
"Safely introduced, the products of genetic modification can bring great benefits to our customers," Tesco technical director Steven Shaw said.
But there was enough doubt about the safety of the new maize to make customers expect "this precautionary action," he said.
The ban will be implemented through Tesco producer clubs, which are a group of farmers supplying meat to Tesco standards, the statement said.
